items.title: West Virginia Legislature takes network offline
items.summary: Legislature IT detected unusual activity on Nov 19 and pulled systems and remote access offline in a suspected ransomware attack; officials have not confirmed ransomware.

items.title: Charleston County, SC confirms data theft
items.summary: County systems remained operational, but officials confirmed data was taken in the attack.

items.title: New Hampshire hospital extends cancellations to Nov 30
items.summary: A New Hampshire hospital hit by a cyberattack has extended appointment and procedure cancellations through Nov 30.

items.title: Inception claims 58GB from Lucid Motors
items.summary: The Inception group lists EV maker Lucid Motors on its leak site, claiming 58GB of stolen data; the claim is unverified.

items.title: INC Ransom claims Advantage Archives
items.summary: INC Ransom listed US records-management firm Advantage Archives with an attack date of Nov 13; status is claimed, not confirmed.

items.title: City of Columbia, SC still restoring services
items.summary: Columbia confirmed ransomware on Oct 24 and is running alternate procedures while affected city systems remain offline.

ransomware.note: Few victims confirmed by name this cycle; Lucid and Advantage Archives are leak-site claims only.

items.title: Microsoft 365 and Workday disruptions (Nov 12–17)
items.summary: Outage timelines list Microsoft 365 and Workday among major SaaS failures in the Nov 12–17 window.

items.title: FAA air traffic network, United, JPMorgan Chase, Apple outages
items.summary: The same mid-November cluster included failures at the FAA's air traffic network, United Airlines, JPMorgan Chase and Apple services.

outage.note: No confirmed AWS, Azure or Google Cloud infrastructure outage found in the past two weeks.

items.title: European Commission hit by AI-generated cyber campaign
items.summary: The Commission says attackers used a publicly available AI tool; the Sysper HR platform and other pay and leave systems were offline for more than 10 days.

items.title: CISA KEV: Apache Axis, REDCap, Synology DSM, LiteLLM
items.summary: CISA added four exploited flaws on Nov 18, including an unauthenticated RCE in Apache Axis (CVSS 9.8); the LiteLLM deadline is Dec 2.

items.title: CISA KEV: GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, OpenSSH, Aspera Faspex
items.summary: Four exploited flaws added Nov 9 with a short Nov 12 deadline; the OpenSSH entry is an authentication bypass fixed in Portable OpenSSH 10.6p2.

items.title: Node2Shell flaw under active exploitation
items.summary: CISA warns attackers are now exploiting the critical Node2Shell vulnerability.

items.title: M 6.8 — 105 km NE of Lospalos, Timor Leste (Nov 21)
items.summary: USGS green alert; no tsunami flag.

items.title: M 6.7 — 7 km ENE of Carhuamayo, Peru (Nov 21)
items.summary: USGS green alert; tsunami flag set.

items.title: M 6.5 — Vanuatu region (Nov 23)
items.summary: USGS green alert; tsunami flag set.

items.title: M 6.4 — Mauritius–Reunion region (Nov 24)
items.summary: USGS green alert; no tsunami flag.

items.title: M 5.9 — 238 km SW of Yanglong, China (Nov 21)
items.summary: USGS yellow alert, so some losses are possible.

items.title: Florida emergency after Brevard County flooding
items.summary: Up to 612 mm (24 in) of rain fell near Malabar on Nov 1–2, prompting a state emergency declaration.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu landfall in Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: Murasu made landfall on Nov 3, the second cyclone to hit the Andhra Pradesh coast in under a week.

items.title: Brazil storm emergencies across 13 states
items.summary: Civil Defense recognised emergencies in 44 municipalities; Santa Catarina logged 671 storm incidents on Nov 4–5.

items.title: Ecuador flooding: 12 dead, 56,000 affected
items.summary: Heavy rain and flooding across Ecuador killed 12 and affected about 56,300 people.

physical.note: Non-seismic events are from early November; no current-month wildfire event found.
